bounds_prior_basis: exploratory TRAIN-only diagnostic outputs/EXP-3D-RGB-PRIOR-BOUNDS-DIAG: the frozen V2 prior leaves 29.7% of TRAIN72 primary-query GT points outside the box, the TRAIN72 q01/q99 prior 2.2%; no DEV, FRESH or protected scene was read
bounds_rule: the frozen GT-free camera-frustum rule with the variant's TRAIN depth prior (context pixel rays cast to its q01/q99, hull x1.1, >=1 m)
checkpoint_selection: independent per variant/seed using the frozen V2 DEV rule; never best seed
context_input: context RGB + cameras only (RGB-only track, RGB_ONLY context loader); no depth of any frame enters construction
context_roles: independent A/B states, equal loss weights
dev_reuse: the 8 DEV scenes were evaluated in V2-V9; V10 is a DEV mechanism diagnostic of the GT-free bounds prior on the RGB-only track, not a qualification round; FRESH-V1 and FRESH-V2 are not used
execution: seeds sequential; the C0/C1/C2 runs of one seed concurrently on CPU cores 8-23 (identical contention); no GPU is used or queried (GPU paused by the user); min_free_gpu_mib is unused
infrastructure_failure_policy: a signal-terminated run, or a run whose log shows a fixed CUDA resource-allocation signature, is moved to audit/failed_attempts with an incident record and rerun from scratch with identical variant/seed/config, at most infrastructure_retries times per run counted across runner invocations; archived checkpoints and DEV curves are never used; any other Python error is never retried; a failed C0/C1 run stops the experiment
initialize: from scratch; identical per-seed shared parameters for all variants, equal to the V5-V9 per-seed draw; no depth bypass
primary_contrast: PRIOR_BOUNDS_GAIN = AbsRel(C0 frozen V2 prior) - AbsRel(C1 TRAIN72 prior), both 32^3
sampling: seeded scene permutation cycled; primary query slot cycles per scene visit; uniform with-replacement rays, identical indices for A/B and all variants
secondary_contrast: GRID16_GAP = AbsRel(C2 TRAIN72 prior at 16^3) - AbsRel(C1); descriptive only
seed_handling: all seeds equally weighted within scene; each seed reported
statistics: frozen V2 estimator (geometry_carrier_statistics) with V7 Amendment 1 (only the C0/C1 ray-hit-fraction equality assertion removed: the bounds prior changes the box by design); its SURFACE_* fields denote the primary C0-C1 contrast, i.e. PRIOR_BOUNDS in V10
train_targets: TRAIN primary_query2 RGB+ray-distance depth; never carrier input
